interpretationRules: Every observed key is materialized as one record even when its Java type, native metadata type, tag ID, byte layout, enum meaning or stock call site remains unknown.
Advertisement in CameraCharacteristics proves visibility only; it does not prove that an ordinary application may write the key or that a write changes the image pipeline.
A public MediaTek source match is a type or semantic hint only until the target build is verified by runtime metadata or a matching target binary.
Characteristic values are retained verbatim per public camera ID and are not converted into enum names without separate evidence.
Session, repeating-request and still-request scope must remain separate when future stock traces add call-site evidence.
Opaque arrays and byte blobs remain UNKNOWN_LAYOUT until a versioned layout and controlled parser test exist.

defaultRecordPolicy.byteLayoutDescription: No target-verified scalar, array or structure layout has been recovered.

typeHints.byteLayoutDescription: Characteristic values are an observed integer array; the public MediaTek-derived metadata mirror suggests MINT64, but packed-field semantics and target native type remain unverified.

updateTriggers: A new firmware build changes the public vendor-key inventory.
The runtime type tracer recovers Java/native type, vendor ID or tag ID.
A stock-app trace identifies a key call site, value or request scope.
A public-source mapping or controlled probe changes confidence or semantics.
